description.text: The starter half deck that opened the Japanese Pokémon Card e series on 1 December 2001, alongside the Card e-Reader and the first e-Card expansion, the Base Expansion Pack. Each 30-card deck was built around one of the six Kanto and Johto starter lines, chosen at random, ending in Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise, Meganium, Typhlosion or Feraligatr, and came with a rule book, paper damage counters and markers, and a Blissey coin. Those six Pokémon were later reprinted as Cosmos holo promos for the Starter Triple Get Campaign, a series of lotteries that needed a copy of this deck to enter. In English, its cards came out in the Expedition Base Set.
